description: Ten synthetic Acme Corp mini audit packs containing deliberately messy interview, checklist, and document-review evidence.
provenance_note: All organizations, people, dates, records, and observations are synthetic. These inputs are raw-style development evidence, not real client records.

evidence.raw_text: Auditee: ISMS Manager. Position: Security Manager. Interview Notes: scope boundaries understood by mgmt incl HQ + cloud ops; discussed last review. could not show documented ISMS scope. Interfaces/dependencies known verbally only.

Checklist Item: information security policy — current / communicated / reviewed? Result: PARTIAL INFO. Notes: approved policy exists on intranet. review date coming up. sample does not show missing required content and no evidence staff failed to receive it. verify next audit.

Auditee: HR lead. Position: Human Resources. Interview Notes: security roles list only has CISO + IT admin. HR says other responsibilities may be in job descriptions but sample not collected today. Cannot confirm whether every required role is assigned and communicated.

Checklist Item: information security risk assessment process established + applied? Result: NON-COMPLIANT. Notes: no approved methodology, no assessment criteria, no risk owners and no completed ISMS risk assessment anywhere in scope. Management confirmed process has not been established.

Document Name: Risk Treatment Pack. Reference: RTP-index / empty. Review Notes: requested risk treatment process, treatment plan, control selection and SoA. none available. no risk-owner acceptance of residual risk. management confirmed risk treatment process not established for any ISMS area.

Document Name: ISMS Objectives Register. Reference: OBJ-REG. Review Notes: blank template only. no information security objectives at any function/level, no target, owner, measure, resource, due date or monitoring record. prior internal note raised same absence; still not implemented.

Auditee: HR officer. Position: Recruitment. Interview Notes: competence checked when hiring; manager coaching happens. auditor did not sample qualification/training records after hire and did not establish any employee was incompetent. follow-up needed on retained evidence and effectiveness checks.

Checklist Item: security awareness. Result: NEEDS VERIFICATION. Notes: no formal annual course, but monthly security emails and onboarding briefing samples exist. audit did not test whether staff understand policy, contribution to ISMS, or consequences of nonconformity.

Document Name: ISMS document index. Reference: DOC-IDX-04. Review Notes: required documents sampled were available and current, access controlled. retrieval took 8–12 min across folders. team plans one indexed location; improvement only, no unavailable document identified.

Auditee: Quality audit lead. Position: Lead internal auditor. Interview Notes: team runs ISO 9001 audits; ISMS audit programme/schedule still being prepared and extra auditor training planned. evidence today does not establish required ISO 27001 audits were missed or programme is absent. confirm scope, frequency and records.
